title: Senior Corporate Sales – Financial Markets
full_description:
Structuring & Advisory
London, United Kingdom
Financial Markets (FM) is the Bank’s gateway to the professional markets around the world. Our primary function is to service the needs of ING’s clients with products, services and guidance. FM aims to be a significant player in our market leader and challenger markets, with an additional presence in all the major international markets and specialist expertise in selected emerging markets and products.
Main Duties and Responsibilities of Role:
Internal Collaboration
Work closely with Debt Capital Markets (DCM), Corporate Finance & Advisory, and the Financial Sponsors Group to identify, pitch and convert event‑driven hedging and financing opportunities
Support Sector Bankers on DCM and Project Finance‑related hedging solutions
Build strong working relationships with the Financial Markets Corporate Sales desk and actively contribute to the development of junior team members
Coordinate effectively with internal Financial Markets stakeholders, including Trading, Balance Sheet Management, Legal, Credit Risk, and Market Risk, to deliver client solutions
External Client Engagement
Develop and maintain meaningful business relationships with corporate clients and financial sponsors
Drive growth by proactively pitching and positioning ING Financial Markets solutions to clients
Actively support clients through their investment, disinvestment and financing cycles, aligning hedging and markets solutions to client needs
Governance & Business Management
Maximise the distribution of ING’s Financial Markets product offering in line with client requirements
Ensure full compliance with all FCA requirements, industry conduct standards and ING compliance policies
Contribute to strategic initiatives and ad‑hoc projects aligned with desk and wider Financial Markets priorities
Qualifications / Education
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification
Professional finance qualification (e.g. CFA Charterholder or progress toward a recognised finance designation)
Demonstrated experience and knowledge in event‑driven hedging, including interest rate and inflation risk, foreign exchange and equity risk, in the context of corporate and project finance‑related transactions
Experience working alongside Debt Capital Markets (DCM) and Corporate Finance / Advisory teams on structured or event‑driven transactions
Strong understanding of pre‑hedging techniques, including deal‑contingent and bond hedging, with experience explaining and positioning these solutions to clients and internal stakeholders
Experience developing and maintaining professional relationships with corporate clients and financial sponsors, or the ability to do so effectively within the role
Personal Competencies
Excellent attention to detail
Entrepreneurial attitude to new business lines
Resilient, professional client service under pressure
Maturity to help others be successful in existing product lines.
ING’s purpose is ‘Empowering people to stay a step ahead in life and in business’. Every ING colleague is given the opportunity to contribute to that vision. We champion self-reliance and foster a collaborative and innovative culture. The Orange Code is our global manifesto for how we stay true to our purpose and our tradition of reinvention and empowerment. It is made up of ING Values (we are honest; we are prudent; we are responsible) and ING Behaviours: (you take it on and make it happen; you help others to be successful; you are always a step ahead)
For us, success will only be achieved if we act with Integrity.
Some companies see diversity as a box to be ticked. We see it as fundamental to our success and we encourage a proper work/life balance.  At ING, you will be judged on your performance in line with the Orange Code. And that’s a promise.
ING Privacy Statement
In order to operate ING’s recruitment process, we will collect and store personal data you provide. Please request the privacy statement should you wish to understand how ING UK uses and protects this information and visit our website for more information.
ING’s vision is to unlock our people’s full potential through our inclusive culture where everyone has the opportunity to develop and have impact for our customers and society. To achieve this vision, our policies support diversity, equity, and inclusion. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not tolerate discrimination of any kind with regard to age, gender, gender identity, cultural background, experience, religion, race, ethnicity, disability, family responsibilities, sexual orientation, social origin, or any other status protected by applicable law. If you require any assistance or if we can accommodate you in any way when participating in our application and/or interview process, please email the recruiting contact listed for the relevant position. We will be happy to work with you to ensure a fair and accessible process. Read more about our commitment to diversity, inclusion and belonging here.
